instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (tabs, buttons, inputs, sliders, cards, checkboxes) contain 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='destination-tab-patagonia', data-testid='submit-booking-button', data-testid='grand-total-display').
Keep currency strictly in EUR (€). Display live breakdown subtotals, accommodation costs, activity additions, estimated taxes (19%), and final grand total.
Inject google font links for Cormorant Garamond, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono into public/index.html or import in index.css.
Implement Lenis smooth scrolling or Framer Motion scroll triggers for buttery motion.
Use Shadcn UI components for Popovers, Calendar, Select, Dialogs, Toasts (sonner), and Tabs, but style them with warm luxury neutrals and dark navy accents.
Provide a full-stack experience where submitted packages persist to backend storage or local persistent DB, and can be viewed/managed in the Team Admin View.
Ensure 'Load Sample' button fills realistic sample itinerary data for quick testing.
Include 'Export JSON', 'Share Package', 'Reset Builder' buttons with interactive feedback via Sonner toasts.
